correctness.rationale: Finite induced one-point extensions of a homogeneous poset correspond bijectively to ideal/filter pairs with each lower member strictly less than every upper member. For a height-two Hasse tree, nonempty mixed profiles are exactly complete bicliques; C4-freeness makes at least one shore singleton, yielding an all-size exact coefficient identity with a single edge-overlap correction. The exhaustive leaf-generator proof, isomorphism-complete center codes, exact integer coefficient comparison, and independent 3^n direct profile checks prove minimality through nine points and two complete size-two fibres at ten. Four explicit witnesses give coefficients H0,H1,M as reported; duality and undirected-tree inequivalence are checked via canonical codes. The executable verification and its exact output are included.

value.rationale: The invariant counts intrinsic complete nonalgebraic one-point types with their lower/upper size grading. The class is structurally motivated: connected height-two Hasse trees, with all-size canonical coefficient formula. Its complete first-failure census reveals two distinct structural information losses (duality and underlying tree nonisomorphism) and the exact minimal size, not a random parametrized example or a scalar recomputation. These are natural reconstruction limits for logical extension profiles.
